output.reason: 45-year-old man with 30 minutes of crushing central chest pressure radiating to the left arm plus diaphoresis and nausea is a possible acute coronary syndrome requiring immediate emergency evaluation with ECG and troponin.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. Crushing central chest pressure for 30 minutes spreading to your left arm with sweating and nausea can mean a heart attack, which needs an ECG and blood tests immediately. Do not drive yourself and do not wait for a reply here. Stay resting; if you collapse or stop breathing, whoever is nearby should tell the dispatcher at once.
differential: Other life-threatening chest pain cause, e.g. aortic dissection or pulmonary embolism
